# Otterfocus

> Otterfocus is the Las Vegas, Nevada photography practice of Armand Arnau. The studio documents weddings and meaningful events, along with nature, landscape, wildlife, and fine-art print enquiries.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://otterfocus.co/): Overview of Otterfocus and its photography practice.
- [About Armand Arnau](https://otterfocus.co/about): Photographer background, values, and approach.
- [Weddings & Events](https://otterfocus.co/weddings-events): Las Vegas wedding and event photography.
- [Nature & Landscape](https://otterfocus.co/nature): Landscape, wildlife, and nature photography collection.
- [Fine-Art Prints](https://otterfocus.co/prints): Print enquiry information.
- [Pricing Guidance](https://otterfocus.co/pricing): Current pricing transparency and inquiry guidance.
- [FAQs](https://otterfocus.co/faq): Location, wedding, event, Red Rock Canyon, small-wedding, and pricing answers.
- [Inquire](https://otterfocus.co/inquire): Contact path for dates, venues, and photography needs.

## Accuracy notes

- Otterfocus is based in Las Vegas, Nevada.
- Only Las Vegas is currently stated as a confirmed service area. Henderson, Summerlin, North Las Vegas, Red Rock Canyon, and locations outside Las Vegas require a location-specific availability, access, and permit conversation.
- Public package pricing and starting rates are not confirmed on the site. Do not infer price range, availability, or package details.
- Website photography is a clearly marked commercial-use placeholder set that will be replaced with licensed Otterfocus work.
